saw_lines: Families buy mobility aids once, under pressure after a fall, and compare on fit, delivery and how fast it arrives.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a worried family decides if the ad is worth a click.
5 of your 13 ads reuse one exact copy, so keep the copy and rewrite the opening line and creative in each of those 5 ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 5 of your 13 ads, so a buyer who sees two of them reads the same words twice. Keep the copy, but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of those 5 ads.
None of your 13 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust before clicking. Pick one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

5 of 13 copy ads open on “rendi la vita di tutti”, so the account rests on one story. Test two new openers against it, one about getting out of bed safely and one about caregivers, each with its own image.
0 of 13 ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Open three new ads with a first order offer or a bundle of two aids, so each new buyer gets a reason to act.
